title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Severely Punishing the Crime of Theft of Communications Equipment According to Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Regulation on Severely Punishing Crimes of Stealing Communication Equipment in Accordance with the Law

Fa (Yan) Fa [1990] No. 15

In order to severely punish, in accordance with the law, crimes of stealing communication equipment and destroying communication lines for the purpose of obtaining exorbitant profits, and to ensure that criminals do not evade due punishment, the following regulations are hereby made:

1. Where the value of stolen communication equipment is not large, but the act endangers public security and constitutes the crime of destroying communication equipment, or where the value of stolen communication equipment is relatively large and constitutes the crime of destroying communication equipment, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 111 of the Criminal Law.

2. Where the value of stolen communication equipment is huge, or where the circumstances are particularly serious, the offender shall be convicted of theft and given a heavier punishment in accordance with Article 152 of the Criminal Law or Article 1(1) of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy.

3. This Regulation shall take effect on the date of its promulgation. Cases of the above-mentioned crimes that are being processed at the time of promulgation shall be governed by this Regulation. Cases that have been adjudicated or ruled upon and have become legally effective before the promulgation of this Regulation shall not be governed by this Regulation.

July 10, 1990
